dedupe_keys.name: higts global thermal stress indices and generation code

description: The HiGTS research team publishes global land-surface thermal-stress estimates derived from ERA5 and ERA5-Land. The collection provides hourly Universal Thermal Climate Index and Universal Thermal Stress, plus daily durations in stress categories, on a 0.1-degree grid. Coverage runs from January 2000 to December 2023. Ninety-six quarterly archives and a GPU-based Python generation package are publicly available and free under CC BY 4.0. These inputs can support heat-exposure and emergency-service demand simulations, with weather comparisons to data-era5-reanalysis and building studies using model-energyplus. A caveat is that a gridded outdoor thermal index does not capture individual exposure, indoor protection or local street geometry. Missing-value conventions and category definitions require attention. No climate arrays, code archive or GPU computation were downloaded or run.
